svg.text: THE 49 SPELLS BY CLASS AND LEVEL
Mage: 25 spells (slots 1 to 5 per level in the spell book)
Cleric: 24 spells; P marks the spells a paladin may pray for (from level 9)
Dashed: spells with no effect. Read Magic and Knock have an all-zero gSpells record (a null callback); Stinking Cloud, Cloudkill and Protection from
Lightning have an empty one. Protection from Lightning is not in the cleric's prayer list (mask 7BFFFFh); Lay on Hands only in the paladin's.
